textureSource.paraphrase: On a GPU without dedicated VRAM, the tenth qualifying level-zero transfer of a non-depth, non-sparse texture asks for in-place reallocation with PIPE_BIND_LINEAR. Width and height must each be at least four.

depthModeSource.paraphrase: The depth-order selection shown here depends on early_fragment_tests and writes_memory; reading fragment Z alone is not an explicit switch to LateZ.

inputSource.paraphrase: A fragment-Z intrinsic marks the Z input and enables POS_Z_FLOAT_ENA.
